title: SAP/BW Data Warehouse Analyst
description:
Data Warehouse Analyst - SAP BW


Location: Harlow or GlenrothesHybrid: 2 days on-site per weekSalary: Up to £65,000 + bonus + excellent benefitsClearance: Must be a sole UK national and eligible for SC clearance

We're recruiting for an experienced Data Warehouse Analyst to join the ERP BW development team of a global aerospace and defence organisation.This is a great opportunity for someone with strong SAP Business Warehouse (BW) experience to take responsibility across the wider BW environment, supporting data warehousing, data management, database design and performance.
The roleYou'll work across the organisation's SAP BW landscape, with responsibilities including:

  • Supporting and maintaining the wider SAP BW environment
  • Administering and troubleshooting SAP BW Process Chains
  • Investigating and resolving data-loading issues
  • Supporting data warehousing and data management activities
  • Working with database design and data structures
  • Troubleshooting and resolving system and performance issues
  • Helping ensure the BW environment remains stable, efficient and reliable

What we're looking for

  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience of SAP BW / Business Warehouse
  • Good understanding of data warehousing and data management
  • Experience administering Process Chains
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve data-load failures
  • Knowledge of database design
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance-analysis skills

Package & benefits

  • Salary: Up to £65,000
  • Pension: 5% employee / 8% employer or 6% employee / 10.5% employer
  • Life assurance: 6x annual salary
  • Bonus: 4% discretionary annual bonus, available from Spring 2028
  • Holiday: 25 days + Bank Holidays, increasing to 26 days after 2 years and 27 days after 5 years
  • Christmas shutdown
  • Option to buy or sell up to 5 days' holiday
  • Free on-site parking
  • Flexible benefits including dental cover, will writing and subsidised gym membership
  • Hybrid working: 2 days on-site in either Harlow or Glenrothes

Security clearanceDue to the secure nature of the work, applicants must be sole UK nationals and eligible to obtain SC clearance. The employer will sponsor and cover the clearance process following acceptance of an offer.
Interested? Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.
